semiconductor_relevance: High — Takada develops and manufactures production equipment specifically for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Takada specializes in production equipment for semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on cutting, cleaning, and stripping processes. Their innovative solutions, such as the semi-automatic machine 'TWPsa' and the fully automatic 'CSX501', enhance productivity and efficiency in sample preparation and material processing.
capabilities: Ultrasonic cutting technology for hard-to-cut materials
Sample preparation equipment for cross-sectional observation
